method: Independent full-document source-PDF caption scan and visual inspection of all identified figure/table pages, using Poppler page renders (plus PDFium reading rotation for one vertical table). No application parser output or model-derived inventory was read before this file was written.

evaluation_levels.deep_review: Two fixed papers: all scientific figure/table pages visually reviewed, 10 semantic cells per paper selected in advance.
evaluation_levels.inventory_only: Five papers: complete numbered-object inventory, not an exhaustive cell/content audit.

selection_note: GSTools transfer was incomplete and was replaced by complete CC BY DAMASK paper before annotation/model comparison. CellFIT later downloaded completely and retained its originally selected deep_review role.
page_index_convention: Zero-based physical PDF page. Printed page numbers, equations, subpanels and bibliography numbers are not additional Figure/Table objects.

papers.scope: Complete original publisher PDF, all numbered main-article objects. External supporting files and their textual references are excluded; publisher logos and body citations are not research objects.
